name: Planning Commission Regular Meeting Notice of Continuation and Adjournment (PDF)
agenda_text:
City of Alhambra

  NOTICE OF CONTINUATION
  AND ADJOURNMENT
  OF THE
  APRIL 20, 2026 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M26-49)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
Planning Commission beginning at 7:00 p.m., Monday, April 20, 2026, in the
Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall is hereby ADJOURNED and the
Public Hearings (Agenda Items 4 – 5) are hereby CONTINUED to the next
regularly scheduled meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission to be held on
Monday, May 4, 2026 at 7:00 p.m., pursuant to the order of the Planning
Commission Secretary.

THE NEXT REGULARLY SCHEDULED MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA
PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE HELD ON MONDAY, MAY 4, 2026,
COMMENCING AT 7:00 P.M. IN THE ALHAMBRA CITY HALL, COUNCIL
CHAMBERS, 111 SOUTH FIRST STREET, ALHAMBRA, CA.

MAIA MCCURLEY
PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY

Dated:  April 21, 2026
Notice No.  N2M26-49
Posted:  April 21, 2026
